summary: ENvue Medical filed an 8-K reporting an October 8, 2026 Secured Promissory Note and Security Agreement with Alpha Capital Anstalt for up to $1,000,000, with a $250,000 initial tranche funded, 10% interest (18% default), maturity December 31, 2026, extendable in three-month increments to 2028, secured by substantially all assets. The company also entered an Amendment Agreement with holders of at least 70% of Series X Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock amending the certificate of designations. No change of control, stake purchase, or special-situation transaction is disclosed; treat as routine financing and charter amendment, watching dilution and collateral overhang.
